name: Hot Springs + Wine Combination Tour
departsFrom: Melbourne CBD; Melbourne Airport; St Kilda; door-to-door pickup
intro: Plunge Wine Tours is a private boutique operation run by Arthur O'Bryan, who brings over 25 years of Mornington Peninsula wine industry experience to every departure. The tour combines private cellar door tastings with a session at Peninsula Hot Springs, Fingal, and operates as an exclusive charter: no shared vehicles, no fixed group departure times.
whatHappens: Door-to-door pickup from the Melbourne CBD, airport, St Kilda, or a nominated address, with departure time negotiated at booking to allow optimal timing at the hot springs. The day sequences cellar door tastings with a two-to-two-and-a-half-hour session at Peninsula Hot Springs, with the order flexible based on the group's preference and the springs' booking windows. Arthur O'Bryan's depth of Peninsula wine knowledge produces access to winemaker conversations and private tasting options not available on standard shared tours. Lunch at a cellar door restaurant is at guest expense. The private Mercedes-Benz Viano allows door-to-door return drop-off.
whoSuits: Small groups of two to eight who want the hot springs and wine combination without sharing the experience with strangers. Groups of four or more who benefit from the reduced per-person rate that makes the premium price more competitive. Those who value a guide with genuine wine industry expertise rather than a generalist tour leader.
whoDoesnt: Couples calculating cost per head at the two-person rate: at $250 to $330 per person, the fare is high relative to alternatives at that group size, and the value calculation only improves meaningfully at four or more guests. Guests who need certainty on whether hot springs entry is included in the tour fare: this is not definitively confirmed in published data and must be verified with the operator before booking.
bookingIntelligence: Confirm whether Peninsula Hot Springs entry is included in the tour fare or at guest expense before booking. If not included, current general bath entry is in the $45 to $75 range per person depending on day and session. Book the hot springs session time in conjunction with the tour booking, or confirm the operator handles this. Bring swimwear and a towel, or confirm hire arrangements at the springs. Groups of four or more attract reduced per-person pricing.

faq.question: Is Peninsula Hot Springs entry included in the tour price?
faq.answer: This is not definitively confirmed in the operator's published data and must be verified directly before booking. The tour is marketed as a hot springs and wine combination, but whether the springs entry fee is bundled into the fare or is a guest-expense item should be confirmed in writing. Current general bath entry is approximately $45 to $75 per person depending on day and session time.

faq.question: What should I bring for the hot springs?
faq.answer: Swimwear is required. Towels can be hired at the springs at additional cost, or bring your own. The outdoor pools range from cool plunge (approximately 15 degrees Celsius) to warm bath (approximately 38 to 40 degrees). Reef-safe sunscreen is recommended for daytime sessions. The combination of wine tasting earlier in the day and extended thermal bathing warrants pacing alcohol intake carefully.

faq.question: How does this tour differ from the shared-group hot springs day tours?
faq.answer: The shared-group operators such as Bunyip run departures for up to 24 guests from approximately $150 per person. Plunge is a private charter with an expert wine guide at $250 to $330 per person. The difference is exclusivity and guide depth: Plunge delivers a private experience with Arthur O'Bryan's specialist Peninsula wine knowledge; the shared-group operators deliver reliable group logistics at a lower price point.
